field.label: Enable Netboot
field.help: Master switch. When unchecked, all Netboot daemons are stopped.

field.label: Listen interfaces
field.help: Interfaces on which Netboot will accept client connections. Auto-firewall rules are added for these interfaces only. Typically your LAN.

field.label: Content root
field.help: Filesystem path that TFTP, HTTP, and SFTP all serve from. Default /var/netboot is fine for nearly everyone.

field.label: Enable TFTP (UDP/69)
field.help: Required for firmware-stage PXE/UEFI bootstrap. Leave on unless you know your clients reach the firewall via UEFI HTTP Boot only.

field.label: Enable HTTP
field.help: Serves the same content root over HTTP for iPXE chainloading and large transfers (menus, kernels, initrds, ISOs).

field.label: HTTP port
field.help: TCP port for the dedicated lighttpd instance. Default 8069 -- chosen to avoid conflict with the OPNsense management webGUI on 80/443.

field.label: Auto-wire Dnsmasq DHCP boot entries
field.help: When checked, on each save Netboot creates (or updates) Dnsmasq DHCP "boot" entries pointing at the Netboot HTTP listen address, with arch-aware tags so both BIOS and UEFI x86_64 clients pick up the right iPXE binary. Has no effect unless OPNsense's built-in Dnsmasq DNS/DHCP service is your DHCP provider.

field.label: Enable SFTP ingress
field.help: Optional. Runs a dedicated sshd instance, SFTP-only, chrooted to the content root, separate from your management SSH. Key-based auth only -- no passwords. Off by default; only enable if you need rsync/sftp-style bulk uploads.

field.label: SFTP port
field.help: TCP port for the SFTP-only sshd. Default 2069. Do NOT set this to 22 -- that's the management SSH port.

field.label: Authorized public keys
field.help: One SSH public key per line (ssh-ed25519 ..., ssh-rsa ...). Any private key holder listed here can sftp into the content root. Public keys only; never paste a private key here.
